cross_topic_conflicts.topics: unmask_ring x unmask_swap (count/ring vs outer-swap lane geometry)
cross_topic_conflicts.conflict: unmask_ring recommends a dense band that hugs the inner area. For VUS it holds 15 bins with centres at max-norm [0.2539,0.3403]; for BUS it holds 16 bins in a rectangle band [0.0425,0.1289] outside a rectangle that includes the buttons. unmask_swap measured outer swaps only with the V4 ring [0.2675,0.45] and counts 3/6/10/15/20, and recommended at least 6 and ideally 10 distractors in the V4 ring. The two cases differ in one important way. In a narrow band, the nearest partner is a neighbour along the band, so the chord runs tangentially and the two +-0.07 m lanes bulge radially: one mover heads toward the inner bins and the other toward the camera border. unmask_swap's own 'tight' ring failed placement at 15 (BUS 297/299), so it gave no answer for 15-16 bins. My pilot joint probe (synthesis/joint_probe.py) reuses the unmask_swap replica, fallback planner and joint sweep proof, with ring A, exact 8-corner visibility, about 0.088 m centre spacing, 1024 trials and the evc criterion. Over 300 layouts per env: VUS 15 bins gave 99.67% of episodes feasible on the first layout attempt (0 placement failures); BUS 16 bins gave 96.99%. Only 44% (VUS) and 29% (BUS) of windows were solved by the first-choice initiator, though. Rejection reasons were exact sweep collision (1581/2010), visibility (1483/802), BUS button keep-out (1352) and inner clearance (898/958).
cross_topic_conflicts.resolution: The two proposals can be combined. With whole-layout redraws (B=16), residual failure is below 1e-20. The price is that the permutation-cycle initiator semantics are diluted: most windows fall back to a later initiator. Before freezing counts, re-run the joint study as gate V5_SWAP_JOINT_FEASIBILITY with the final implemented sampler (unified OBB rule, not my circle approximation) and at least 300 layouts per env. If the first-attempt rate falls below 0.95, or the user dislikes the heavy fallback, go back to the user (L16) with three levers: ring C (g=0.04, 16/16), outer lane 0.05, or letting only a subset of distractors swap. The counts are decided once for both topics (L16 supersedes unmask_swap D4/D5).

cross_topic_conflicts.topics: unmask_ring P2 x unmask_swap P1/P4 (both rewrite utils/unmask_swap_xhard.py)
cross_topic_conflicts.conflict: Both proposals rewrite sample_distractors, build_distractors and XHARD_DISTRACTOR. They disagree in four places. (1) Cube placement: unmask_ring uses cube_bins = randperm(count)[:n] with balanced colour cycling and names distractor_cube_<j>_<colour>; unmask_swap assumes cube i sits in bin i (as in V4 build_distractors) and builds distractor_cube_bin_pairs from that. (2) unmask_swap adds a whole-layout attempt loop plus an appended randperm(count) for initiators; unmask_ring adds a unified OBB rule, exact visibility and 1024 trials. (3) Draw order within the dedicated stream is unspecified in both. (4) V4 names cubes distractor_cube_<colour>, which crashes with a duplicate-name error once colours repeat.
cross_topic_conflicts.resolution: Use one owner and one implementation, with this frozen order on the dedicated stream Generator(seed+0x5D157AC7). For each layout attempt: placements (x, y, yaw per trial; unified OBB rule, exact visibility, H1 inner-sweep rejection), then n_cube randint, colour randperm(3) cycled, cube_bins randperm(count), swap perm randperm(count), then the deterministic plan. Call recorder.value only for the accepted attempt and record the attempt count. Build distractor_cube_bin_pairs from cube_bins, never from the index. Use indexed names everywhere. Keep the main stream untouched (N5) and pin the order with a replica-vs-env parity test.

cross_topic_conflicts.topics: unmask_ring P7 x unmask_swap P5 (two different sweep pre-filters)
cross_topic_conflicts.conflict: unmask_ring proposes an XY lane-capsule pre-filter inside unmask_swap_xhard, before check_swap_sweep, to cut the extra 10-50 s of reset time. unmask_swap proposes a certified bounding-circle/sphere pre-filter inside bin_collision (new check_multi_swap_sweep) and measured 4.75 s -> 0.0025 s on 40/40 identical decisions. VideoRepick's reset planner (R) also calls check_swap_sweep repeatedly.
cross_topic_conflicts.resolution: Build one certified pre-filter in bin_collision, used only by the new check_multi_swap_sweep and an opt-in wrapper. Leave check_swap_sweep's decisions unchanged; it runs only on xhard and on the retired 甲 path, so V1 is not exposed. Gate: PREFILTER_EQUIV (at least 1000 randomised cases, 0 disagreements), plus MULTI_SWEEP_EQUIV (equal to check_swap_sweep for one pair). VideoRepick may use the same wrapper for planning.

cross_topic_conflicts.topics: binfill_cluster x pick_swing_cluster x movecube x videorepick (cube 2D-OBB degeneracy fixed four different ways)
cross_topic_conflicts.conflict: _trimesh_box_to_obb2d projects R[:2,0] and R[:2,1]. For a cube, trimesh's axis order is arbitrary, so a placed cube often degenerates into a 4 cm segment and min_gap is not enforced. Rate: 66% on the investigators' float32 path, 50% in my float64 trimesh replica, 5/11 in the real simulator. Four fixes were proposed: BinFill passes pre-made true OBB tuples in avoid; PickXtimes/SwingXtimes add a _cube_avoid_obb helper plus an 8 cm extra_reject; MoveCube passes include_existing=False for the exec cube; VideoRepick adds a min_center_dist/center_ref_xy kwarg (a 0.12 m hard core that masks the bug). The untouched xhard envs PickHighlight and VideoPlaceButton/Order keep the bug.
cross_topic_conflicts.resolution: Add one pure helper, utils/xhard.py::cube_obb2d_exact(pose, half), with no RNG, and pass its (c, A, h) tuples through the existing pre-made-tuple branch of avoid in the xhard paths of the touched envs only. Never edit _trimesh_box_to_obb2d or _safe_unit: that would change all tiers and fail V1 (H2/N12). Extending the fix to the untouched envs is a separate user decision (L2), because it would force those envs to be re-frozen too.

cross_topic_conflicts.topics: movecube x pick_swing_cluster x videorepick (hooks on shared spawn_random_cube / spawn_random_target)
cross_topic_conflicts.conflict: Three different new kwargs are proposed on object_generation.spawn_random_cube and spawn_random_target, which all 12 layout envs and all tiers call: reject_xy (MoveCube), extra_reject (Pick/Swing), and min_center_dist + center_ref_xy (VideoRepick). Three variants of the same hook in a shared function triple the V1 exposure and invite drift.
cross_topic_conflicts.resolution: Add a single additive kwarg extra_reject=None (callable (x, y, yaw) -> bool) to both functions. It is evaluated after the existing OBB/circle tests and before recorder.value, and draws no RNG. The default None skips it entirely, following the V4 corner_bias precedent. Each topic expresses its rule as a closure: MoveCube zone, 8 cm or 0.12 m centre distance, PickXtimes quadrant. Gates: RESET_REGRESSION diff=0, V5_UNTOUCHED_XHARD_PARITY (the 40 untouched-env xhard rows reproduce bit-exact), V1.

cross_topic_conflicts.topics: videorepick x long_demo x unmask_swap x pick_swing_cluster (SceneGenerationError shadowing)
cross_topic_conflicts.conflict: I checked every env module. The global name SceneGenerationError is the utils submodule, not the class, in VideoRepick, SwingXtimes, PatternLock, RouteStick, StopCube, VideoUnmaskSwap and ButtonUnmaskSwap; VideoPlaceOrder already has the K2 alias. As a result, xhard failures that V5 adds or relies on turn into TypeError, and generate_dataset classifies TypeError as a non-retryable code failure. Affected paths: VideoRepick placement and plan failures (8.4% plan rejections); the SwingXtimes disk failures (1.9% -> 3.6% under pick_swing P2, raised and caught through the shadowed name); PatternLock PL-E 'raise SceneGenerationError on exhaustion'; any env-level raise from unmask_swap P4. The V4 draw loop caught every Exception, so draws still redrew, but the fail_class was wrong.
cross_topic_conflicts.resolution: Apply the K2 pattern to the xhard paths of VideoRepick, SwingXtimes, PatternLock, VideoUnmaskSwap and ButtonUnmaskSwap: a _RealSceneGenerationError alias, with the class chosen by difficulty at both the raise and except sites. Leave the original tiers as they are (H2). Gate: V5_SCENEGEN_CLASS. Decision L3.

cross_topic_conflicts.conflict: The topics read N5 differently. unmask_ring appends after existing draws or uses the dedicated stream. VideoRepick appends one torch.rand. InsertPeg moves peg_3 before obj/dir and draws yaw lazily. MoveCube redraws in place. PickXtimes, SwingXtimes, BinFill and VideoRepick change trial counts. RouteStick and PatternLock change only ranges. Every one of these shifts xhard stream positions for a given seed; none touches easy/medium/hard.
cross_topic_conflicts.resolution: Make one global decision (L1): N5 protects the original tiers and frozen artifacts, and the xhard stream may shift in place (V4 corner_bias precedent), so all touched xhard envs are re-frozen under v5-01. Under a strict literal reading, InsertPeg P1, MoveCube P1 and the Pick/Swing/VideoRepick spacing rules would be blocked, and RNG-neutral maps (MoveCube P5) would be needed.

cross_topic_conflicts.topics: videorepick x unmask_swap (swap semantics and planning infrastructure)
cross_topic_conflicts.conflict: VideoRepick R changes the xhard partner to 'uniform among the 2 nearest sweep-feasible slots, planned at reset with a 5 mm margin'. Unmask Swap keeps the inner nearest neighbour resolved at runtime and plans the outer nearest neighbour at reset against nominal states, without a margin; runtime start states are about 0.7 mm off nominal. Both touch the step() swap loop, which test_real_swap_resolution_matches_baseline_and_preserves_ties extracts through the AST (it covers VideoUnmaskSwap and VideoRepick).
cross_topic_conflicts.resolution: Keep the per-env semantics the user asked for. Share the infrastructure: check_multi_swap_sweep, the certified pre-filter, and reset-time planning with deferred recorder.value. Borrow VideoRepick's small planning margin for the Unmask outer plan (checked with inflated shapes) to absorb the 0.7 mm start deviation. Put the xhard branches in step() behind getattr(self,'difficulty',None)=='xhard' and getattr defaults, and put the outer swap loops outside the AST-locked loop. Run the AST test on every commit.

consolidated_pending_decisions.question: How to read N5 for V5: may xhard draws shift in place (in-place rejection, reorder, changed trial counts), given that the original tiers stay byte-identical?
consolidated_pending_decisions.options: (a) Accept xhard-only in-place shifts and re-freeze every touched env under v5-01 (V4 corner_bias precedent). (b) Strict literal N5: only appended draws, which needs RNG-neutral maps (MoveCube P5) and blocks InsertPeg P1 and the spacing rules in Pick/Swing/VideoRepick/BinFill.
consolidated_pending_decisions.reason: Every topic's recommended design needs it. The original tiers are protected by V0, V1 and RESET_REGRESSION, and V4 xhard specs cannot be replayed under V5 anyway.

consolidated_pending_decisions.question: Scope of the fix for the cube 2D-OBB degeneracy (min_gap not enforced)
consolidated_pending_decisions.options: (a) xhard only, in the envs V5 touches (BinFill, PickXtimes, SwingXtimes; MoveCube via include_existing=False; VideoRepick is masked by its 0.12 m hard core). (b) Also PickHighlight, VideoPlaceButton and VideoPlaceOrder xhard, which forces those to be re-frozen. (c) A global fix, which breaks V1 and is forbidden by H2/N12.
consolidated_pending_decisions.reason: It removes near-touching cubes where the user complained, and the 4 untouched envs keep their V4 artifacts.

consolidated_pending_decisions.question: Fix the silent truncation of inner bins in ButtonUnmaskSwap (`except RuntimeError: break`) for xhard?
consolidated_pending_decisions.options: yes (raise the real SceneGenerationError, per 2.2④) / no

consolidated_pending_decisions.question: Distractor count and ring for the Swap envs now that outer swaps exist (supersedes unmask_swap D4/D5; joint with L6-L10)
consolidated_pending_decisions.options: (a) unmask_ring's counts (VUS 15, BUS 16) in the hug ring, adopted if V5_SWAP_JOINT_FEASIBILITY reaches a first-attempt rate ≥ 0.95. consolidated_pending_decisions.question: Rule for choosing the outer initiator
consolidated_pending_decisions.options: (a) randperm(count)[:3] cycled k%3. (b) randperm(count) cycled over all distractors. (c) A fresh randint per window.
consolidated_pending_decisions.reason: Equal to (a) when count is 3; it moves almost all distractors and gives the fallback an ordered list.

consolidated_pending_decisions.question: What to do when a window's first-choice outer swap is infeasible
consolidated_pending_decisions.options: (a) Deterministic fallback to the next initiator, then a whole-layout redraw as the last resort. (b) Redraw only. (c) Skip the outer swap.
consolidated_pending_decisions.reason: (b) introduces heavy bias; (c) breaks 'every inner swap has an outer swap'.

consolidated_pending_decisions.question: Meaning of 'lanes do not enter the inner region'

consolidated_pending_decisions.reason: (c) is essentially impossible with ±0.07 m lanes; (b) is feasible in both the V4 ring and the hug ring (pilot).

consolidated_pending_decisions.question: Spacing metric, and whether to keep the native root rule (> 0.075)
consolidated_pending_decisions.options: exact footprint (oriented rectangles) + keep native / capsule + keep native / centre distance only

consolidated_pending_decisions.options: (a) One loop over the 4 pegs before obj/dir, with lazy yaw. (b) Pegs 0-2, then obj/dir, then peg 3 through the same function. Yaw: lazy / joint / yaw-first.

consolidated_pending_decisions.options: yes / no

consolidated_pending_decisions.question: What does 'peg not in the centre' mean?
consolidated_pending_decisions.options: (A) The centre of the peg's own jitter box, zone 2.74 cm. (B) Additionally, the peg body must stay out of the workspace centre (about 8.5% extra redraws). (C) Nothing extra.

consolidated_pending_decisions.reason: The root is always at |y| ≥ 0.15, so a workspace-centre rule does nothing for it.

consolidated_pending_decisions.question: Reference box for the cube zone
consolidated_pending_decisions.options: The candidate box, w = 0.0548, applied to both candidate and final / the final support box, w = 0.0712
consolidated_pending_decisions.reason: Checking only the final position causes 6% of layouts to fail; checking only the candidate lets 9.9% leak into the zone; the larger zone raises reach risk.

overall_summary:
[Internal output, in English] I synthesised the 8 V5 investigations and ran 24 spot-checks: 22 confirmed, 1 uncertain (a joint pilot model) and 1 refuted (a new cross-topic defect).

Key answers:
- 最近2邻 means the single nearest neighbour measured on 2 axes (XY). The only '2 nearest' helper, _compute_dynamic_swap_candidates, is dead code.
- InsertPeg's 4th peg comes from a separate near-target band sampler, (0.075, 0.085] around peg_0, drawn after obj/dir. A root distance of 0.075 allows overlap (my MC: 26% target-vs-4th peg).
- corner_bias 0.5 is the main cause of PickXtimes corner piling (obstacle-free MC: 54.5% vs 13.7% sharing a corner cell). The OBB-degeneracy bug adds near-touching cubes.
- The BinFill red clump is chance, amplified by the OBB bug (recomputed p=0.027 post hoc; P(majority ≥7)=21%).
- A 5×5 PatternLock tops out at 25 nodes, about 27.4 s on average, so it cannot be centred on 30 s. The six V4 demo frame counts are confirmed from h5.
- The density-derived Unmask counts reproduce (V4 ring 24.3; ring A 15.3).
- The MoveCube exec-cube spawn defect reproduces in the real simulator (seeds 1000442/1000446).

Largest cross-topic issues:
1. The dense hug ring (15/16) combined with outer nearest-neighbour swaps was never measured by either topic. My pilot joint probe gives 99.7% (VUS) and 97.0% (BUS) first-attempt feasibility, but only 44% / 29% of windows are solved by the first-choice initiator. It is gated as V5_SWAP_JOINT_FEASIBILITY, and L16 is a joint decision.
2. SceneGenerationError is shadowed into a module in 7 envs. Beyond VideoRepick this includes SwingXtimes, PatternLock and both Unmask Swap envs, so V5's new xhard rejections would surface as TypeError. The K2 fix needs extending (L3).
3. Four divergent OBB and spacing fixes plus three different spawn_random_* hooks should be unified into one inert extra_reject kwarg and one exact-OBB helper.
4. Two different sweep pre-filters and a (10,10,10) parking pile-up are shared between unmask_ring and unmask_swap.

Everything can stay xhard-only. The only shared-code edits are additive (spawn_random_* kwarg, a new bin_collision function, new utils/xhard helpers). statechange.py and _trimesh_box_to_obb2d must not be touched.

V5 overturns B3, B6, B7, B8 (layout), B9, B12, B13, G3, I2, J2, K1 and K3. It modifies A2 (window), H1, J1, J5 and B1 (enforcement), and extends K2.
